stops.name: Posada de Valdeón
stops.detail: The Cares route or trail is a hiking route in northern Spain located between the province of León and Asturias, in the Picos de Europa National Park —Short Distance path PR-PNPE 3​—, specifically between the Leonese town of Posada de Valdeón and the Asturian municipality of Poncebos.

stops.name: Cordiñanes de Valdeón
stops.detail: The Cares continues its progress passing through the village of Cordiñanes de Valdeón (43 inhab.) until reaching Caín de Valdeón (58 inhab.), where the valley narrows and boxes in, marking the start of the true Cares gorge or canyon.

days.title: The Divine Throat Traverse
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Caín
stops.detail: Currently, a part of the traverse, the one that ran between Posada de Valdeón and Caín, can now be done by road -in addition to the trail- and for that reason it is hardly traveled.

stops.name: la garganta divina
stops.detail: The most popular route is the section of just over 12 km corresponding to Caín-Poncebos (or Poncebos-Caín): it runs at mid-height in the wildest part of the gorge —also known as "the divine throat"—, excavated in the almost vertical gray limestone walls, most of the time flying over dangerous precipices without any protection.
